title: User reference: blue animatronic, editable character test v001

acceptance_criteria.description: Machine-readable geometry and preview report exists
Front preview is published; all four requested views must also pass worker gates
Inspect all four previews: full body, large rounded head, squat torso and segmented limbs are coherent with the supplied reference
Inspect distinctive details: two incisors, twin muzzle, glasses with white stripes, ears, headphones, tuft, hat, bow, bands and pale toes
Inspect geometry and report: named separate editable parts, rigid limb rig and no missing or grossly detached major components
